title: Crop Infuser
description: The Crop Infuser is a single-block glass automaton that incubates a seed placed in its left seed slot and periodically deposits harvests into a three-row.
body: The Crop Infuser is a single-block glass automaton that incubates a seed placed in its left seed slot and periodically deposits harvests into a three-row, 27-slot output inventory on the right, with upgrade slots beneath the seed to speed growth, boost yields, or add bonus drops (Growth Accelerator, Bountiful Harvest, and Lucky Sprout stackable up to four tiers). Right-click the Infuser to insert a seed or open its GUI, right-click while holding upgrades to install them (upgrades and seeds can also be inserted by hoppers from non-bottom faces), extract products from the right side (bottom extraction is limited to product slots), and use quick-move for outputs; the block saves and drops its inventory when broken and now drops the matching Infuser item for non-creative players so you can pick it up and relocate it. Each wood-type Crop Infuser is available as its own placeable item and crafting recipe for all vanilla wood types (Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark Oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Pale Oak, Bamboo, Crimson, and Warped), appears in the Crop Infuser creative tab, preserves its variant when broken, and each variant has its own themed item/block textures and proper break particles; the generic base Infuser has been removed so only the wood variants are obtainable.
